# Whop

Making everyone an internet entrepreneur. Explore a playground for digital products, memberships & communities.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/whop/.

## Actions

- **Create Access Token**: Create a short-lived access token for authenticating API requests.
- **List Members** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of members for a company.
- **List memberships** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of memberships with filtering options.
- **List Payments** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of payments for a company.
- **Retrieve Company** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing company.
- **Retrieve Member** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about an existing member by ID.
- **Retrieve Plan** (read-only): Retrieve information about an existing plan.
- **Retrieve User** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing user from Whop.
- **Update Plan**: Update a plan's pricing, billing interval, visibility, stock, and other settings.
- **Create file**: Create a new file record and receive a presigned URL for uploading content to S3.
- **Delete Promo Code**: Archive a promo code, preventing it from being used in future checkouts.
- **List Apps** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of apps on the Whop platform.
- **List Authorized Users** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of authorized team members for a company.
- **List Payment Methods** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of payment methods for a member or company.
- **Retrieve App** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing app.
- **Retrieve Authorized User** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing authorized user.
- **Retrieve company token transaction** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing company token transaction.
- **Retrieve File** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing file from Whop.
- **Retrieve Promo Code** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing promo code by its unique identifier.
